_comment: Tier-2 for dune::poisson#10, dune::nonlinear#3 and dune::poisson_mms#1 — one fixture because all three are assertions about the parameter dictionary of the SAME compiled scheme, so the C++ module is built once (wall time 2 s on a warm cache, 2026-08-06, dune-fem 2.12.0.2). Measured: parameters={'newton.tolerance': 1e-10} emits a UserWarning whose text is "Warning: the parameter key 'newton' is deprecated. Replace with 'nonlinear' to avoid this warning!" and scheme.parameters comes back [('linear.method', 'cg'), ('nonlinear.tolerance', 1e-10)] — rewritten, and the scheme still solves, so the old keys work. 'newton.linear.tolerance' gets its own text, "the parameter key 'newton.linear' is deprecated. Simply remove 'newton.'". Passing 'newton.tolerance' AND 'nonlinear.tolerance' is accepted with no error and the nonlinear.* value (1e-12) is the one kept; only the nested 'newton.linear.*' + 'nonlinear.linear.*' pair raises KeyError. parameters={'nonlinear.maxiter': 3, 'totally.bogus.key': 42} produced an EMPTY warning list and ran to the normal answer, while 'nonlinear.maxiterations' does survive into scheme.parameters — so the cap typo is silent. NOTE for whoever edits expect_in_output: dune-fem wraps the key names in the warning in ANSI colour escapes, so the quoted phrase "key 'newton' is" does NOT appear as contiguous text; match the uncoloured fragments instead. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 passes the current spelling 'nonlinear.tolerance' where the base run passes the deprecated 'newton.tolerance'. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectations 'newton_prefix_warned=True', 'is deprecated. Replace with', 'dune_parameter_key_handling_verified=True' are no longer printed and the forbidden token 'FAIL:' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness). ENVIRONMENT: there is no ofa-dune conda env on this host, which is the interpreter scripts/run_tier2_fixtures.py falls back to; dune-fem 2.12.0.2 lives in ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env. Without DUNE_PYTHON set to that interpreter the runner records this fixture as `skipped`, not `failed`, so a summary that counts only passes and failures shows nothing wrong while nothing was executed. Every measurement quoted above, and the mutation verdict, was taken with DUNE_PYTHON=~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python.
